title: Edmund and the Spire
author: E. M. Whitlock
blurb: Petra Underhill, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
